system.longDesc:
Bullets trail a bright “tracer” line through the air, easily visible, particularly in darkness or dim light, showing their trajectory. Tracers are typically used in automatic weapons, with every third or fourth bullet a tracer round. Whenever a character performs an Automatic Weapon stunt using a gun loaded with tracers, they gain an additional +1 bonus to their next attack roll with that weapon as the tracers help them to aim.
